name: paper_id
description: Stable row identifier assigned during curation.

name: pdf_filename
description: Exact PDF filename in the dataset pdfs folder.

name: paper_title
expected_format: Title case as printed by source; minor punctuation variants acceptable.
example_answer: Engineering of high-precision base editors for site-specific single nucleotide replacement

name: doi
description: Digital Object Identifier for the article.
evidence_expectation: Article metadata, title page, or source log.

name: editing_modality
description: Genome-editing modality emphasized by the paper.
expected_format: Short label such as cytosine_base_editing, C_to_G_base_editing, prime_editing, multiplex_base_prime_editing.

name: main_editor_or_system_name
description: Primary named editor or platform introduced, optimized, or benchmarked.
expected_format: Canonical paper terminology; separate multiple names with semicolons.
evidence_expectation: Abstract, main results, and figure legends.

name: best_or_selected_variant
description: Best-performing or selected variant highlighted by the authors for the main assay.
expected_format: Variant name exactly or compactly as reported.
evidence_expectation: Results text and plots comparing variants.

name: primary_assay_system
description: Main cell type, organism, or experimental system used to establish the editing result.
expected_format: Concise biological system; include cell line or organism when available.
evidence_expectation: Methods/results around the primary editing assay.

name: highest_reported_editing_efficiency_percent
description: Highest reported on-target editing efficiency relevant to the main editor claim.
expected_format: Percent as number only; use the paper-reported denominator and note exact target during annotation if needed.
evidence_expectation: Quantitative result text, figure axes, or source data table in the main PDF.

name: construct_or_editor_architecture_compact
description: Compact architecture of the editor, construct, or guide array. Use underscore-separated modules in observed order.
expected_format: Promoter_or_expression_context_domain1_domain2_domainN; no spaces; use unknown only when main PDF lacks a schematic.
evidence_expectation: Figure schematic plus caption and construct description. Vision evidence is expected when a schematic is present.

name: architecture_source_figure
description: Main figure panel containing the construct, editor, or array architecture schematic.
expected_format: Figure panel label such as Fig. 1a or Extended Data Fig. 2b.
